How do effective, inactive, neutral, unsupported, and partially supported Held item choices participate in the complete calculation identity, effect-equivalent Scenario merge, result ordering, Damage Conditions Card, and warning display?

The answer must cover separate attacker and defender item Tracks, merged source sets, hidden neutral choices, and static-item N-hit warnings without changing the established information-hierarchy contract.
